newborn-timing-window.headline: Newborn timing gives a window
newborn-timing-window.hint: Take out the time window or sleepy-baby reason. Newborn sessions have no set time.

newborn-timing-answer.headline: Newborn timing answer is missing
newborn-timing-answer.hint: This page should say there's no set time: two weeks or twelve, they're still your little newborn.

no-mt-eliza.headline: Mt Eliza is named
no-mt-eliza.hint: Mornington replaced Mt Eliza in the service area. A photo description can still say where it was taken.

frankston-not-first.headline: Frankston leads the location
frankston-not-first.hint: Lead with Cranbourne East. Frankston can stay further along the list.

doubled-place-names.headline: A place is named twice
doubled-place-names.hint: Cranbourne East already covers Cranbourne here. Take out the repeat.

suburb-list.headline: Suburb list is missing Officer or Pakenham
suburb-list.hint: Suburb lists start from Cranbourne East and include Officer and Pakenham.

single-price-from.headline: A session price says "from"
single-price-from.hint: Prices are straight now: write "$395", not "from $395". Keep "from" only on a line that sums up several sessions.

session-lengths.headline: Session length doesn't match the booking
session-lengths.hint: Glimpse books 30 minutes and Golden 60. A different length here promises a session the booking can't give.

no-em-dash.headline: An em dash is in the copy
no-em-dash.hint: Deep's rule: no em dashes. Use a comma, colon or full stop instead. Don't swap in an en dash or spaced hyphen.
